//exclude-artifacts: Generated aztec codegen wrappers (src/artifacts/*.ts) are dead code — the app loads the raw JSON via loadGeneratedArtifactJson, never these classes. Their codegen-embedded artifact object omits aztec_version and fails the strict NoirCompiledContract cast, so exclude the generated dir from type-checking.
//exclude-tests: Test files (src/**/__tests__) and vitest.config.ts import from `vitest`, a devDependency. `next build` type-checks the whole tsconfig program, so including them couples the PRODUCTION build to vitest being installed — which breaks `docker compose --profile aztec up` (the frontend image's node_modules omits/lags devDeps). Vitest runs these via its own config regardless of tsconfig, so excluding them here keeps `npm test` working while decoupling the build from test tooling.
//exclude-root-owned: The pre-v6 docker bootstrap wrote src/artifacts as root; such a dir can only be renamed aside (src/artifacts.root-owned-*), and `next build` would otherwise type-check those stale v4 codegen copies and fail on '@aztec/aztec.js/*'. Keep them out of the program too.
